name: ready-check
description: Judge one inbound pitch, offer or scam email for an AI agent: structured findings, never replies.
long_description: Ready Check by ReadyUpAgents tells your agent what an inbound email really is before anyone answers it: a sponsorship below your rate card, a guest post that is really a paid link, a pay-to-play PR or podcast pitch, a security report fishing for a bounty, or a cold pitch dressed up as a lead. It also flags phishing, scam signs and prompt injection. It returns structured findings (kind, verdict, scores, named checks, sender-domain facts) and does not write a reply, connect to an inbox, or send mail. ready_check_quick is a free rule-only screen with no key. A standard check costs $0.0025; credit comes in $2 and $5 packs paid by card on Stripe Checkout.
